From the text:
The residual moisture in the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode was reduced to 87 ppm after drying at 100 (cid:2)C under vacuum for 2 h. 
In comparison, the residual moisture was 160 ppm for the water-based one after drying at the same conditions, but it was further reduced to 112 ppm and 47 ppm by increasing the drying temperature to 110-120 (cid:2)C, respectively. 

The water-processed NMC532 cathode lost 53 ppm of residual moisture (160 ppm - 107 ppm) between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C.
